reviews.title: Excellent Programs
reviews.text: I’ve been using Peak Strength for almost a year and tried various programs in the app. I’m a 5’4” 140lb 41yo former basketball player with knee, back shoulder and ankle issues. For years I couldn’t lunge or squat and this program got me back on track in about 6 months. I was even doing Olympic lifts that I’d never attempted before. I have a pretty solid foundation and feel confident that I can begin working more on the running and plyos without the fear of injuring myself. I have a desire to be able to move well and play rec sports. This app has drastically improved my chances of doing so. Now I can squat 195, bench 115, and power clean 75 with no assistance.

reviews.title: Non-Athlete Friendly!
reviews.text: I’d been lifting for about 6 months prior to getting started with this app and loved all of the detailed instructions! I felt comfortable trying new things and confident that I’m doing them right. I’m just a regular lady (late 30s, haven’t done sports since high school) and was looking for something to help decrease symptoms of aging. The workouts are difficult in a great way and it feels like I have a coach telling me what to do each workout. I get stronger every workout and look forward to continuous progress. 100% worth it!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
First, let me say that I am a big fan of Dane Millers YT videos and that there is no denying that he’s a world class expert in strength training. But I don’t think the AI used in this app properly reflects his expertise. I’ve used it for 10 weeks now and there are too many questionable program choices by the AI. For example today was Upper Body Hypertrophy day but the warmup consisted solely of lower body movements: lunges, heel-toe walk etc. 
Also, the effort gauge seems to be off frequently. For example, dips come easy to me.  I can knock out 20 with strict form but the app regularly gives me sets of 7 and 9 with no weight even when I report that such sets are easy. OTOH, I reported that 7 chins with BW+20 was a max effort and it gave it to me again the next set.   There are other instances like this.
Finally, I thought it was cool that someone there contacted me after me first 20 workout to see how I was doing. But when I responded, no answer. I replied again and again no answer.
All in all it’s not a bad app but I will be canceling soon. Maybe when they get the AI further along I will try again.

reviews.title: Needs a pause feature
reviews.text:
I love this app. Having gone through 2 programs on the old version and 1 on the new, I have noticed a big difference in my overall sports performance and functionality.

However, not being able to pause the program is really inconvenient. I understand that you can “reschedule” workouts but for someone who gets swept away with work every once in a while - rescheduling every day I can’t work out is a bit much.

I also get that you can just go back on the calendar but I ran into a couple problems with this: One is that the app became really buggy. Seconds, is that after my program schedule completed, it would not let me go back to pick up where I left off. I had to start a new program.

I understand that there are workarounds but a pause feature would just make the user experience so much better.

reviews.title: Don’t hesitate. Do this program.
reviews.text: This app is amazing. If you’re trying to get fit, it will ramp you up slowly so that you stick with the program. If you’re training for something sport-specific, you can adjust your program to reflect that. I did the ski season to prep for winter skiing (recreational) and have noticed such a difference this year in how comfortable I am on the slopes. I switched to the weight loss program and am seeing a change in my body composition. The programming utilizes progressive overload and is varied enough to stay interesting. There are videos for people unfamiliar with movements and it is easy to make substitutions if you don’t have access to equipment. I have a background in Olympic Weightlifting, so a solid understanding of good programming, and I can’t imagine there is a better app than this one out there. Highly recommend to both beginners and to athletes.

reviews.title: Best hybrid/athlete style training app
reviews.text: As a tennis player, I’ve been wanting an app to meet my strength and agility goals. This app is perfect for that. I’ve felt myself become faster, stronger, and build useful strength. The workouts feel purposeful and aren’t overwhelming. It’s easy to navigate and adjust things. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a great workout app to become the athlete they dream of!

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: I’ve trained with a coach before, but it was just too expensive. Being able to use this app to develop a program for me to work out at home is exactly what I needed. I would only suggest doing the barbell Olympic lifts if you have had a coach before to tell you if you’re using proper form. If you are trying it without a coach, do not be afraid to go slow and use lightweight and practice good form.

reviews.title: Great Programming, Buggy App with bad Support
reviews.text:
I never leave reviews, but compelled to do so given the less than desirable support. I recently signed up for a free trial. Once my trial ended I was sent an email for a Black Friday deal. I followed the link and was charged the full amount for the subscription. I have reached out to support numerous times requesting to be able apply the promo to my account. Still have not gotten any response. Why send a promo if you can’t even honor it?

I love the athletic programming and have recommended to friends, but the bugs that time out the app between sets and less than desirable customer support has me going back to TrainHeroic.

reviews.title: Great Training Program & App with Bugs, Horrible Customer Service
reviews.text: I have been working with athletic performance programming for years. The only training app that comes close to these designed programs are the programs you can purcahse through TrainHeroic. I would have kept using the app, but after my trial period the promotion that was offered to me didn't work and no one would repsond to my messages requesting to have this offer applied to my account since the discount URL didn't work. I would have stayed a cusotmer, but the lack of response from the support team and buggy issues with the app closing during rests between sets was annoying enough to have me leave a program that I enjoyed.
